# Intro to ggplot

## What is it?

- R package that implements Wilkinson et al's "grammar of graphics" [@Wilkinson2005-do]
  - Written by [Hadley Wickham](https://hadley.nz), CTO of Posit.co
- Maps data to figure components
  - Position (on axis)
  - Color (lines and fills), shape, size, texture
- Add layers to figures, e.g., annotations

## Why 'code' your figures?

- Easier to reproduce
- Easier to edit
- Try out different styles, pick the best
- Be kind to your future (forgetful) self
- Makes programming more fun

## Basic *ggplot* components

- A data frame (rectangular dataset: rows are observations, named columns are variables)
- Function call to `ggplot()`
- Add layers to plot with `+` operator
- Add aesthetics (mappings between data and graphic elements) using `aes()` with x (and often y) mappings
- A `geom_` layer
